title: Beyond Autoregression: Discrete Diffusion for Complex Reasoning and Planning

contributions.purpose: 解释为何自回归(AR)模型在复杂推理/规划任务上失败,以及扩散模型为何更优
contributions.mechanism: 提出并分析'subgoal imbalance'(子目标难度不均衡)视角;在合成规划任务上给出理论与实证证据,论证扩散训练目标把难子目标分解为multi-view学习框架下多个更易学习的视图
contributions.evaluation: 合成planning任务:AR/Reverse AR在planning distance(PD)≥2时接近随机猜测;扩散模型在所有PD上达完美准确率;AR需指数级更多数据学难子目标(数据低效)
contributions.source_quote: Through the lens of subgoal imbalance, we demonstrate how diffusion models effectively learn difficult subgoals that elude autoregressive approaches.

contributions.purpose: 进一步提升离散扩散模型在复杂规划任务上的学习效果与收敛速度
contributions.mechanism: 提出Multi-Granularity Diffusion Modeling(MGDM),在序列级reweighting基础上增加token级reweighting机制,按子目标难度加权优先学习
contributions.evaluation: 消融(Tab.3):token-reweighting带来显著提升,序列-reweighting仅微小提升;easy-first(TopK)解码优于随机;multi-granularity loss在训练中段收敛更优
contributions.source_quote: We propose Multi-Granularity Diffusion Modeling (MGDM), which prioritizes subgoals based on difficulty during learning.

contributions.purpose: 在复杂问题求解任务上实证离散扩散大幅超越AR(无需搜索)
contributions.mechanism: 在Countdown、Sudoku、Boolean SAT(NP-complete)上对比MGDM与AR/Reverse AR/Teacherless,以及GPT-4的IO/CoT/CoT-SC/ToT prompting
contributions.evaluation: MGDM在Countdown/Sudoku达91.5%/100%,AR仅45.8%/20.7%;Game of 24上ToT虽提升GPT-4但耗token是MGDM的186倍;MGDM单步扩散比AR快10x且精度更高(75% vs 45.8% Countdown4)
contributions.domain: 语言模型推理与规划(组合/约束满足问题)
contributions.source_quote: On complex tasks like Countdown, Sudoku, and Boolean Satisfiability Problems, MGDM significantly outperforms autoregressive models without using search techniques.

self_declared_provenance.quote: we propose a natural extension to current discrete diffusion models, which we term multi-granularity diffusion modeling (MGDM)
For text, the diffusion model can be seen as an extension of the traditional iterative NAR models (Gong et al., 2022)
We follow Gandhi et al. (2024) to generate 500k problems ... we also compare with such approaches by training on Countdown 4 and evaluating on the same game of 24 test set as Yao et al.(2024).

notes: 整体是diffusion压倒AR的正结果论文,但含若干trade-off/caveat:(1) 扩散因x_t采样随机性,采到同一x_t概率降为1/C(...),potentially reducing training efficiency——正是MGDM要补偿的;(2) SAT任务变量增多时MGDM与AR准确率均下降,只是MGDM下降更慢(gap变大);(3) decoding speed是显式accuracy-speed trade-off,靠扩散步数调节;低复杂度任务速度优势更明显,高复杂度需牺牲效率换性能;(4) teacherless training拟合不足、产生非法路径。AR的'Regretful Compromise'错误分析是核心finding。
